sourceEntry: 2026-10-24 — FreePBX click-to-call and selective recording (local source)
releaseSummary: Contact dialog has a Calls tab: a Call button rings the staff member's own extension, then dials the customer through FreePBX, and shows recorded calls with summary, transcript and playback. Only calls staff choose to record are kept. Needs the migration, `PBX_AGENT_TOKEN`, function deploys and the PBX agent install in `docs/pbx-calls-setup.md`; recording consent and retention steps are required before use. Not applied, deployed or installed.

moduleImpact.notes: Updated as part of FreePBX click-to-call and selective recording (local source).

migrationNotes: No manual data migration is required for this release.
